lessons.key: process ownership through a worker crash
lessons.claim: A job tag only on an exiting publisher is insufficient ownership evidence for its surviving untagged children. In the revised candidate, independently tagged guardian and executor stay alive after work; cleanup retains one tag until other members stop. This preserves evidence across either single-process crash. Unknown untagged groups remain unsignalled; simultaneous loss of every ownership witness is not proven recoverable. Keep requested journal and source heads distinct from the last accepted publish, and keep failure retry admission independent of ordinary ticks.
